Bluetooth speakers play about 150–300 ms late. Delay the headphones by the same amount so both sound together. Wired: 0 ms.
Smaller buffer = faster response. If the sound crackles, choose “Safe”.
Copy MP3 files to your phone, open the library and tap “Rescan”. Tap A or B to load a track into a deck.
SYNC matches the tempo and the beat of this deck to the other deck, so both play in time.
How can I pre-listen on headphones?
You need a splitter cable, a USB audio interface or two output devices. Choose the mode under Settings → Audio, then tap the headphone button on a deck.
Why is my Bluetooth speaker late?
Bluetooth always adds a delay. Set the headphone delay under Settings → Audio so headphones and speaker match.
Open Requests, start an event and show the QR code. Guests need no app. With “Local Wi-Fi” no internet is required.
In the “Music” folder on your phone, in a sub-folder with the app name, as WAV files.
Two-deck DJ app for your own music: beat sync, EQ, effects, Auto-Mix and guest requests via QR code.
Time-stretching (tempo without pitch change): own WSOLA algorithm

Privacy in short:

• Your music stays on your phone. It is never uploaded.
• The app has no ads, no tracking and no user accounts.
• Guest requests (Internet mode): the event name, the song list titles and the requests are stored on our server (Google Firebase, EU) and deleted automatically after 24 hours. Guests are identified only by an anonymous ID for spam protection.
• Local Wi-Fi mode: nothing leaves your phone.

Full privacy policy: see the app’s store listing.
Open the library, load tracks into deck A and B and mix with the crossfader.
BPM is detected automatically. SYNC matches tempo and beat. EQ, filter and echo for smooth transitions.
Fill the queue – the app mixes in time on its own. Take over whenever you want.
Show a QR code – guests send requests from their phone. Works even without internet.
No next track – add tracks to the Auto-Mix queue
OK – the app may run in the background without restrictions.
Battery optimisation is on. Android may stop the music in the background after some time. Recommended: set this app’s battery usage to “Unrestricted”.
Tip: allow unrestricted battery use (Settings → Audio) so Auto-Mix keeps running in the background
The music stops in the background?
Settings → Audio → Background playback → open app settings → Battery → “Unrestricted”. On Samsung also remove the app from “Sleeping apps” (Settings → Battery → Background usage limits).
Tempo differs a lot – no beat blend

Each song pair is analysed (beats, phrases, intro/outro, breaks, vocals). Auto-Mix picks a fitting transition, starts the next song exactly on the downbeat and never puts two vocal parts on top of each other. Move the crossfader yourself at any time to take over.
